The [[Spectral Vaettir]] is a type of [[Nightmare]] found in the [[Haunted homestead|south-east section]] of [[Jaga Moraine]], near the [[Sacred Altar]].

* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Jaga Moraine}}

== Notes ==
* They deal [[earth damage]] from [[melee]] range. In Hard mode, they deal 32-35 damage against targets with 60 [[armor rating|armor]].
* They are not [[fleshy]].
* In Hard mode, there are exactly 60 Vaettir in the southeast corner of Jaga Moraine near the portal to [[Bjora Marches]]. Fewer will spawn in normal mode and before completion of [[Flames of the Bear Spirit]].
* Similar to [[Raptor Nestling]]s, the large number of homogenous foes makes Vaettirs exploitable for [[farming]]:
** The intended gains include [[seasonal item]]s, [[Item rarity|gold weapons]], Glacial Stones, Mesmer [[skill tome]]s, and/or [[experience]] (for [[Survivor]]).
** Effective [[Soloing|solo]]-farming [[builds]] use [[spell targeting prevention]] to force the Vaettirs into melee range or high health regeneration to counter the hexes, combined with [[block]]ing and/or [[damage reduction]] against earth damage to survive their [[attack]]s.
** This makes them vulnerable to non-[[Area damage over time#NPC scattering behaviour|scattering]] [[area of effect]] damage. Scattering skills can be used if the Vaettirs are [[body block]]ed against a corner before damaging them.
** See also: [[Guide to vaettir farming]]

== Trivia ==
* Spectral Vaettirs were the target of [[keg farming]] until the [[Game updates/20090611|June 11, 2009 update.]]
